verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents automatic generation of llms.txt and llms-full.txt for published docs sites, and this is confirmed live in practice on Mintlify's own docs (200 response serving an agent-oriented llms.txt index plus per-page .md markdown mirrors). This directly matches the story's requirement of automatically serving llms.txt and a full-content variant for agent indexing. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation (beyond Mintlify's own dogfooded site) that llms-full.txt specifically renders full content across arbitrary customer sites.
